description: This file defines the ModelDataFile class, which models the structure and metadata of data files used within the Ofbiz framework. It includes properties such as filename, delimiter, record length, encoding, and a list of record definitions, facilitating file parsing and processing.

classes.name: ModelDataFile
classes.description: Represents a model for describing data files, including their structure, delimiters, record formats, and metadata necessary for processing different types of data files.

methods.name: getModelRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ModelRecord from the list of records by its name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the data file.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the data file.

methods.name: getTypeCode
methods.description: Returns the type code, which can be used to identify the file type.

methods.name: setTypeCode
methods.description: Sets the type code for the data file.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the sender entity of the file.

methods.name: setSender
methods.description: Sets the sender entity of the file.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the receiver entity.

methods.name: setReceiver
methods.description: Sets the receiver entity.

methods.name: getRecordLength
methods.description: Returns the length in bytes of each record if fixed length.

methods.name: setRecordLength
methods.description: Sets the record length.

methods.name: getDelimiter
methods.description: Returns the delimiter character used in the file.

methods.name: setDelimiter
methods.description: Sets the delimiter character.

methods.name: getStartLine
methods.description: Returns the line number where reading starts.

methods.name: setStartLine
methods.description: Sets the starting line for reading the file.

methods.name: getSeparatorStyle
methods.description: Returns the style of separators used (fixed-length or delimited).

methods.name: setSeparatorStyle
methods.description: Sets the separator style.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the file.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the file.

methods.name: getEOLType
methods.description: Returns the end-of-line type (CRLF or CR).

methods.name: setEOLType
methods.description: Sets the end-of-line type.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Returns the list of record definitions.

methods.name: setRecords
methods.description: Sets the list of record definitions.

methods.name: getEncodingType
methods.description: Returns the character encoding type.

methods.name: setEncodingType
methods.description: Sets the character encoding type.
